EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Section 125 Nondiscrimination Testing Reminder
EmailTemplate.subject: Section 125 Nondiscrimination Testing Questionnaire Reminder
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello client name,
I hope you are well and having a great fall season. As we get close to the end of the year, I'd like to remind you of the upcoming email communication sent out by our Section 125 Team (email sent from the address Insperity Benefits <InsperityBenefits@response.insperity.com>) prompting you to complete the required annual Section 125 Nondiscrimination Testing Questionnaire.
This Nondiscrimination Questionnaire (NDQ) is an annual requirement as it supplies critical information for Insperity to perform IRS-required nondiscrimination testing on the Insperity Group Health, Health Care FSA and 401(k) plans. The questionnaire also is used to determine applicable large employer (ALE) status under the Affordable Care Act. ALL clients must submit this information annually for each Insperity client parent company (client ID numbers ending in 00).
Since you have an Insperity Group Health Plan and/or have access to the Insperity Health Care FSA, you will need to complete the questionnaire for Section 125 Nondiscrimination Testing even if you do not have an Insperity 401(k) plan. It is important that you complete the questionnaire in a timely manner so that your employees can maintain their pre-tax benefits.
I have attached the PDF instructions for completing the questionnaire on Insperity Premier and included a summary below.
Individuals with confidential security role - Login in to http://portal.insperity.com Click "Regulatory and Compliance" under Company Select "Section125 / Nondiscrimination Testing" under Government Reporting Select "Access Now" Select "Begin Questionnaire"
If you've previously completed the questionnaire with Insperity, you will need to verify and/or update business information and submit it for plan year 2025.
If you need assistance answering any portion of the questionnaire, we are here to help you. Please contact the Insperity Contact Center, option 1 at 866-715-3552 (weekdays between 7am and 7pm CST) and a team member can assist you.
Sincerely,
